title: IT Equipment Support Policy
content:
Employees should report unresolved docking-station issues through the internal IT support portal.

The report must include:
- Laptop model
- Docking-station model
- Description of the issue
- Troubleshooting steps already attempted

A replacement docking station requires approval from IT.
Employees should not purchase a replacement themselves.

title: Password Reset Policy
content:
Employees must use the company self-service password reset portal to reset a forgotten password.

If they cannot access the portal, they must contact IT support.

Employees must never share passwords or verification codes.

title: VPN Access Policy
content:
Remote access to internal company systems requires the approved VPN.

Employees must obtain IT approval before VPN access is enabled.

If a VPN connection fails, record the error message and contact IT.
